title: Open, read and close a task budget through the full sign-and-submit lifecycle
instruction: Open a task budget with a cap of {amount} USDC and a ttl_minutes of 20, then take it through its FULL lifecycle: open it, sign the open handoff with haven_sign, submit the signature with haven_submit, read it back with haven_get_task_budget (it must read open), close it with haven_close_task_budget, sign the close handoff with haven_sign, submit that signature with haven_submit, and read it back again with haven_get_task_budget (it must read closed). The open and close tools only PREPARE a haven_sign handoff — nothing changes until the signature is submitted. Tell the user the final state.

source.note: haven_open_task_budget and a live haven_close_task_budget only prepare: they return a haven_sign handoff and state does not change until it is signed and submitted (mcp-server/src/tools/task-budgets.ts:120-166). The grader reads the FINAL state from the backend, because tool_called only proves a call occurred.

commandTemplate: mkdir -p "$QA_EVAL_TRIAL_HOME/claude-cwd" && cd "$QA_EVAL_TRIAL_HOME/claude-cwd" && claude -p {instruction} --output-format stream-json --verbose --model sonnet --max-turns 30 --allowedTools mcp__haven-eval mcp__haven-signer-eval --disallowedTools Bash,BashOutput,KillShell,Read,Edit,Write,NotebookEdit,Glob,Grep,WebFetch,WebSearch,TodoWrite,Task,SlashCommand,ExitPlanMode,Skill,Workflow,ToolSearch,Monitor,CronCreate,CronDelete,CronList,ScheduleWakeup,SendMessage,ListAgents,TaskStop,EnterWorktree,ExitWorktree,PushNotification --mcp-config "$QA_EVAL_TRIAL_MCP_CONFIG" --strict-mcp-config
